title: The six Australian colonies federate as the Commonwealth of Australia
summary: The Commonwealth of Australia was proclaimed at a ceremony in Centennial Park, Sydney, uniting six British colonies into one federal dominion with Edmund Barton as first prime minister.
reason: Concerns over defence, trade barriers between colonies and a growing sense of shared national identity drove the federation movement through the 1890s.
significance: It created the Australian nation and its federal constitution, still in force today.
